verified_facts: BET PER HAND cycles1,2,3,4,5,10 when all ten positions are active
SELECT HANDS enabled at one credit; adds one position and wraps10to1
BET PER HAND on a partial one-credit board activates another position
First BET PER HAND after a settled round resets all ten positions to one credit
BET MAX sets all ten positions to ten credits and starts a deal when credits suffice
BET MAX short funds configures floor(credits/10) ordinary coins capped5, without a deal; tiny fallback selectsonecoin
BET PER HAND affordability check uses10*min(currentcoins+1,5), otherwise selectsall10onecoin
Royal initial deal automatically holds all five and starts the draw settlement
Win rollup timing is client presentation; payout math arrives from server
SEE PAYS preview is independent of the actual game wager, initialized1 and retained across opens; BET UP/DOWN follows1,2,3,4,5,10 without wrapping
SEE PAYS preview10 highlights the five-credit payout column and multiplier column; preview1..5 highlights only the corresponding payout column
